description: Alex's chat note, 2026-08-16: "leverage radish/go-snap in tai?". radish is already in use for the consent prompt (cmd/tai/consent.go:64, since 0edfe13). go-snap, his snapshot-testing library, is not used anywhere in tai. title: Evaluate go-snap for tai's tests
